HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

2. Which response best shows understanding of The Enlightened Beings? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Enlightened Beings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Enlightened Beings.
   C. Say The Enlightened Beings has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Names of Scriptures? (1 mark)
   A. Say Names of Scriptures has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Names of Scriptures to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Names of Scriptures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Names of Scriptures.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Simple postures? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Simple postures.
   B. Use Simple postures to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Simple postures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Simple postures has no place in daily life.

5. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

6. Which response best shows understanding of Myself? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Myself with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Myself.
   C. Say Myself has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Myself to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette.
   B. Say General Etiquette has no place in daily life.
   C. Use General Etiquette to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

9. Which response best shows understanding of Places of Worship? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Places of Worship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Places of Worship.
   C. Say Places of Worship has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Places of Worship to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain The Enlightened Beings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Names of Scriptures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Simple postures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
